body.heading: Where in the world is Guyana?
paragraphs: Guyana is a country in South America.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Guyana is Georgetown.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Guyana is English.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Guyana is the Guyanese dollar.

body.heading: How big is Guyana?
paragraphs: Guyana covers about 215,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Paraguay.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Kaieteur is one of the world's most powerful single-drop waterfalls — the Potaro River plunges 226 metres in pristine rainforest, home to tiny golden frogs.
Guyana's Rupununi is a land of giant anteaters, arapaima lakes and Amerindian villages, beside the Iwokrama rainforest reserve.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Guyana on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
